notes.content: DIVERSITY REQUIREMENT FOR CAL STATE LA GRADUATION

The articulation information in Assist.org not only shows a link to the admission requirements (aka our Major Specific Criteria webpage) but also Cal State LA graduation requirements that may be completed at the lower-division level, prior to transferring to the University. The diversity requirement is a graduation requirement , not an admission requirement. The diversity requirement may be completed prior to, or after, transferring to the University. For the Cal State LA degree, students will be required to complete two courses (six units) certified as diversity courses, at least one focusing on issues of race and ethnicity and their intersectionality with other social categories that structure inequality in society. These courses can be completed either at the lower-division or upper-division level from among courses satisfying GE requirements. Please view the General Education agreements on Assist.org for the lower-division courses that will meet the Diversity (d) and Race & Ethnicity (re) Requirements.

notes.content: Students pursuing the Bachelor of Arts degree in English select one of two options. I. General Option (15-16 units) - The General Option is intended for those pursuing a liberal arts education with special emphasis on literature and writing; students can focus their General option programs by taking electives in one of several defined tracks or individually tailor their programs in consultation with a college adviser. II. Single Subject Credential Teaching (SSC) Option (20-22 units) - Students interested in teaching middle or high school English should complete this option and meet minimum GPA requirements to be eligible for certification of subject area competency. Students majoring in English should obtain advisement prior to or during their initial semester of major coursework. Those majoring in English are urged to acquire command of at least one language other than English. The total number of units required for the Bachelor of Arts degree in English is 120 units, of which 49-56 units are in the major. Consult with an adviser for the specific number of units required in all areas of the degree, including GE and free electives.
notes.contentHtml:
Students pursuing the Bachelor of Arts degree in English select one of two options.


  • I. General Option (15-16 units) - The General Option is intended for those pursuing a liberal arts education with special emphasis on literature and writing; students can focus their General option programs by taking electives in one of several defined tracks or individually tailor their programs in consultation with a college adviser.


  • II. Single Subject Credential Teaching (SSC) Option (20-22 units) - Students interested in teaching middle or high school English should complete this option and meet minimum GPA requirements to be eligible for certification of subject area competency.


Students majoring in English should obtain advisement prior to or during their initial semester of major coursework. Those majoring in English are urged to acquire command of at least one language other than English.


The total number of units required for the Bachelor of Arts degree in English is 120 units, of which 49-56 units are in the major. Consult with an adviser for the specific number of units required in all areas of the degree, including GE and free electives.
